column1: # Short descriptions the game shows when a player finds an answer. Always
# write one for the gem and Fool's gold; any other answer can have one too.
# name can be any name the answer goes by. Keep each to two sentences.

column2: Found in Serbia's Jadar valley in 2004. Its formula is almost exactly the one on the kryptonite case in Superman Returns, minus the fluorine, and it's white, not green.
An amphibole named after Cummington, Massachusetts. Every geology student has sniggered at the name, so it's nowhere near as rare an answer as it feels.
